subject: planner: choose the better unique index (#50185)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent. Main behavior change is in `pkg/planner/core/stats.go` (`DataSource.derivePathStatsAndTryHeuristics`): when multiple point-range unique-index access paths require double scan and have the same number of point ranges, it now prefers the path with fewer `TableFilters` (i.e., more predicates absorbed into index access), affecting PointGet/BatchPointGet index selection only. Added plan-case test `TestPointgetIndexChoosen` asserting composite unique index is chosen when it matches all WHERE predicates. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, data consistency, compatibility, or transaction/concurrency behavior. The tie-break logic still exists on `upstream/master` (no later fix-up indicating a regression).
